'''Pokémon Adventures: The Mythical Moltres''' is the eleventh monthly issue released by [[VIZ Media]] of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Mato]]. It contains chapter twenty-six of the {{MangaArc|Red, Green & Blue}}. The chapter originally released in this book was later rereleased as part of {{PAV|2}}. As a bonus, it contained a sheet of Pokémon stickers which were not included with the collected volume release.
